verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a self-serve audience export, such as a CSV or other open-format download of contacts, custom fields, tags, engagement history and suppression lists. The only related material is general API read access ('pull data from Klaviyo', headless read via APIs/MCP, paginated event retrieval). Those are developer building blocks for constructing an export, not the export capability itself, so they earn no credit.
